scripts.build: pnpm --filter @mfe/user-administrator build && pnpm --filter @mfe/shell build && pnpm --filter @mfe/server build
scripts.db:up: docker compose --env-file infra/nginx/.env.local --env-file packages/server/.env.local --env-file packages/server/.env.secret up -d --wait postgres
scripts.db:down: docker compose --env-file infra/nginx/.env.local --env-file packages/server/.env.local --env-file packages/server/.env.secret down
scripts.db:reset: docker compose --env-file infra/nginx/.env.local --env-file packages/server/.env.local --env-file packages/server/.env.secret down --volumes
scripts.nginx:up: docker compose --env-file infra/nginx/.env.local --env-file packages/server/.env.local --env-file packages/server/.env.secret up -d --wait nginx
scripts.nginx:down: docker compose --env-file infra/nginx/.env.local --env-file packages/server/.env.local --env-file packages/server/.env.secret rm -sf nginx
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build
